Interface IF_GameController

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
Controller
public interface IF_GameController extends Remote
Controller's Interface for ModelViewController pattern.
Interface for the methods that the View calls directly on the Controller in order to communicate its Moves.

  • Method Details

    • chooseTile

      void chooseTile(String nickname, Tile tile) throws IOException
      Client's notification about Move CHOOSE_TILE.
      This method is called by the Clients in order to notify the Controller about its Move CHOOSE_TILE.
      Pre: nickname != null && tile != null
      Parameters:
      nickname - Nickname of the Player who has moved.
      tile - Tile chosen by the Player.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • showRankings

      void showRankings(String nickname, boolean response) throws IOException
      Client's notification about showing the Rankings.
      This method is called by the Clients in order to notify the Controller about their willingness of seeing the Global Rankings.
      Pre: nickname != null
      Parameters:
      nickname - Nickname of the Player who has notified the Controller.
      response - True if the Player wants to see the Rankings, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.
